game.title: Homefront
game.blurb: First-person shooter from Kaos Studios, Digital Extremes and THQ, published by THQ and Deep Silver, released 2011-03-15. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genre: Shooter. Chapters follow the seven campaign chapters named in the Steam achievements, plus difficulty, collectibles and multiplayer.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 19365). The Steam store list has app 55100 ("Homefront"); its schema is named "ValveTestApp55100" (a placeholder name). 2 of 47 Steam achievements are hidden: "Safer Skies" (34.8%), which RAWG describes as destroying the SAM trucks in Chapter 6: Overwatch, so it sits in Chapters 4 to 7; and "Tea Party" (3.2%), which RAWG also leaves blank, so it sits in Chapters 4 to 7 as a placeholder. "Destructive Duo" (second seat of the Apache) and "Action Hero" (bailing out of a helicopter) do not say which mode they belong to; they were put in multiplayer as a guess because their API numbers (51, 52) follow the multiplayer ones. StrategyWiki has no page under "Homefront" or "Homefront (2011)". homefront.fandom.com answers the API under "Homefront" with about 91 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Splitting the seven chapters 3 and 4 is our own choice.
